resources.string: control Pangolin tunnels, enabling and disabling tunnels at will.
Disable Always-On VPN in Android settings before disconnecting.
Keep a status notification while connected. A temporary notification may still appear when connecting or recovering. Android’s own VPN indicators are unaffected.
Allow notifications for Pangolin in Android settings to show VPN status.
Connect the tunnel while a selected app is open and disconnect when it closes, unless the tunnel was already running.
Opening any selected app activates the tunnel.
Pangolin needs usage access to detect which app is in the foreground.
